name: 78578 · Port Isabel, TX
findings: ZIP 78578 (Port Isabel) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78578 (Port Isabel) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
